top.name: CC0 原始男体 · 制服上衣与领带
top.method: Mapped original VRM0 top, compacted referenced rows with original ordered triangle corners, UV0, normals, normalized weights, raw bone transforms and inverse binds.
limits: Exact publisher body SHA and selected top only. Native VRM0 source coordinates and raw skeleton retained.
Standalone unlit export carries the original base-color PNG, sampler and alpha settings; original MToon shading, normal and emissive channels are not reproduced.
Source and CPU fit readback only; game motion, contacts and coverage require separate evidence.
